Aerial Surveys International Awarded GSA Multiple Award Schedule Contract

2026-09-16 Geo Week News Aerial Surveys International, GSA, government contract, GIS, aerial imagery, LiDAR, geospatial, federal procurement, TrinityGEO
Read the source article

Quick summary

Aerial Surveys International has been awarded a GSA Multiple Award Schedule contract, enabling federal, state, local, and tribal agencies to directly procure its GIS and Earth observation services — including aerial imagery, LiDAR, and geospatial analytics — as a prime contractor.

Key takeaways

  • Aerial Surveys International (ASIntl) awarded GSA Multiple Award Schedule (MAS) contract for GIS and Earth observation services
  • Contract covers SIN 541370GIS (GIS services) and SIN 541370GEO (Earth observation solutions) — placing ASIntl among select contractors authorized for both under a single GSA vehicle
  • Federal agencies including USGS, USDA, NOAA, USFS, FEMA, DHS, NGA, and FAA can now issue task orders directly without separate competitive procurement
  • ASIntl maintains teaming agreements with 27 partner organizations representing nearly 4,000 professionals
  • The award strengthens the TrinityGEO geospatial intelligence framework developed with Polygon Solutions and Urban Hawk
  • State, local, and tribal governments also gain direct access for disaster preparedness and emergency response GIS purchases
